mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 3.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and industrial production signals robust economic activity and corporate demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high GDP growth regimes, accelerating economic activity drives corporate earnings growth that precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high GDP growth regime (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized), the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above 3.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output and economic activity that precedes stronger corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1,300,000 units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300.0 in the prior month.
